about: Every user-facing string of both patchers. Keys are stable; {name} marks a placeholder. 'draft' marks Indonesian not yet reviewed by a native speaker. See DESIGN.md, Wording and language.

a_newer_patcher_version_is_available.en: A newer patcher version is available.

you_have_the_latest_patcher_version.en: You have the latest patcher version.
you_have_the_latest_patcher_version.id: Anda sudah memakai versi patcher terbaru.

your_patcher_version_is_newer_than_the.en: Your patcher version is newer than the latest release.
your_patcher_version_is_newer_than_the.id: Versi patcher Anda lebih baru dari rilis terbaru.

github_is_limiting_update_checks_try.en: GitHub is limiting update checks. Try again later.
github_is_limiting_update_checks_try.id: GitHub membatasi pemeriksaan pembaruan. Coba lagi nanti.

no_published_patcher_release_was_found.en: No published patcher release was found. Try again later.
no_published_patcher_release_was_found.id: Rilis patcher belum ditemukan. Coba lagi nanti.

github_could_not_check_for_updates_try.en: GitHub could not check for updates. Try again later.
github_could_not_check_for_updates_try.id: GitHub tidak dapat memeriksa pembaruan. Coba lagi nanti.

update_check_timed_out_try_again.en: Update check timed out. Try again.
update_check_timed_out_try_again.id: Waktu pemeriksaan pembaruan habis. Coba lagi.

cannot_reach_github_check_your_internet.en: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
cannot_reach_github_check_your_internet.id: Tidak dapat menghubungi GitHub. Periksa koneksi internet lalu coba lagi.

the_release_information_could_not_be.en: The release information could not be read. Try again later.
the_release_information_could_not_be.id: Informasi rilis tidak dapat dibaca. Coba lagi nanti.

a_newer_release_has_no_downloadable.en: A newer release has no downloadable Android APK yet. Try again later.
a_newer_release_has_no_downloadable.id: Rilis terbaru belum menyediakan APK Android untuk diunduh. Coba lagi nanti.

finish_patching_or_recovery_before.en: Finish patching or recovery before updating the patcher.
finish_patching_or_recovery_before.id: Selesaikan patch atau pemulihan sebelum memperbarui patcher.

no_browser_could_open_the_download.en: No browser could open the download. Install a browser and try again.
no_browser_could_open_the_download.id: Tidak ada browser yang dapat membuka unduhan. Pasang browser lalu coba lagi.

start_shizuku_then_come_back_here.en: Start Shizuku, then come back here.
start_shizuku_then_come_back_here.id: Jalankan Shizuku, lalu kembali ke sini.

new_messages_appear_here_as_we_work.en: New messages appear here as we work. Scroll to see earlier messages.
new_messages_appear_here_as_we_work.id: Pesan baru muncul selama proses. Gulir untuk melihat pesan sebelumnya.

free_up_space_confirmation.en:
Removes leftovers from earlier or interrupted runs, and saved game apps this game version no longer needs.

The original game files the patcher changed are always kept, so you can still remove the translation or switch languages without clearing game data.

Keep the game closed while this runs.
free_up_space_confirmation.id:
Menghapus sisa proses sebelumnya atau yang terhenti, dan aplikasi game tersimpan yang tidak lagi diperlukan versi game ini.

File game asli yang diubah patcher selalu disimpan, jadi Anda tetap bisa menghapus terjemahan atau mengganti bahasa tanpa menghapus data game.

Biarkan game tertutup selama proses ini.

remove_saved_apks.en: Also remove all saved game apps, including the recovery copy (about {saved}). The next patch needs about {prepare} free to copy them again.
remove_saved_apks.id: Hapus juga semua aplikasi game tersimpan, termasuk salinan pemulihan (sekitar {saved}). Patch berikutnya memerlukan sekitar {prepare} ruang kosong untuk menyalinnya lagi.

finish_work_before_freeing_space.en: Finish the current work before freeing space.
finish_work_before_freeing_space.id: Selesaikan pekerjaan saat ini sebelum mengosongkan ruang.

freed_kept.en: Space freed. The record for switching languages and the saved game app were kept.
freed_kept.id: Ruang dikosongkan. Catatan untuk mengganti bahasa dan aplikasi game tersimpan tetap disimpan.

freed_removed_apks.en: Space freed. The record for switching languages was kept. The saved game apps were removed; the next patch prepares them again.
freed_removed_apks.id: Ruang dikosongkan. Catatan untuk mengganti bahasa tetap disimpan. Aplikasi game tersimpan dihapus; patch berikutnya menyiapkannya lagi.

kept_saved_apps_installed_not_one.en: Kept the saved game apps: the installed game app is not one of them
kept_saved_apps_installed_not_one.id: Aplikasi game tersimpan tetap disimpan: aplikasi game yang terpasang bukan salah satunya

closed_run_nothing_half_changed.en: Closed an interrupted run that left no game file half-changed
closed_run_nothing_half_changed.id: Proses terhenti yang tidak meninggalkan file game setengah berubah telah ditutup

closed_run_game_changed_files.en: The game changed its files after the translation was written; closing the run without checking them again
closed_run_game_changed_files.id: Game mengubah file-nya setelah terjemahan ditulis; proses ditutup tanpa memeriksanya lagi

recovered_unconfirmed.en: Recovery finished. Normal game app verified. The translation was written and checked, but the game changed its files afterwards, so they were not checked again. If some text is Chinese, tap Start to patch again.
recovered_unconfirmed.id: Pemulihan selesai. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi. Terjemahan sudah ditulis dan diperiksa, tetapi game mengubah file-nya setelah itu, sehingga file tidak diperiksa lagi. Jika ada teks berbahasa Tionghoa, ketuk Mulai untuk patch lagi.

after_reinstalling_check_the_game_app.en: After reinstalling, check the game app below. Unfinished file changes still need recovery.
after_reinstalling_check_the_game_app.id: Setelah memasang ulang, periksa aplikasi game di bawah. Perubahan file yang belum selesai tetap perlu dipulihkan.

language_note_no_clear.en: Switching languages? No need to clear: the patcher kept the original game files it changed.
language_note_no_clear.id: Mengganti bahasa? Tidak perlu menghapus data: patcher menyimpan file game asli yang diubahnya.

language_note_clear_first.en: If another patcher or an older version translated this game, clear its data before you switch languages.
language_note_clear_first.id: Jika game ini diterjemahkan patcher lain atau versi lama, hapus datanya sebelum mengganti bahasa.

remove_confirmation.en:
This writes the game's original files back, so the game reads in Chinese again. No game data is deleted and no download is needed.

The game keeps the patcher-signed app: keep using Scan to login. For the official app, reinstall the game from the store.
remove_confirmation.id:
Ini menulis kembali file game asli, sehingga game kembali berbahasa Tionghoa. Data game tidak dihapus dan tidak perlu mengunduh ulang.

Game tetap memakai aplikasi bertanda tangan patcher: tetap gunakan Scan to login. Untuk aplikasi resmi, instal ulang game dari toko.

nothing_to_remove_no_record.en: This patcher has no record of a translation on this phone, so there is nothing to remove.
nothing_to_remove_no_record.id: Patcher ini tidak punya catatan terjemahan di ponsel ini, jadi tidak ada yang dihapus.

nothing_to_remove_official.en: The game on this phone is the official build, which this patcher never translated, so there is nothing to remove.
nothing_to_remove_official.id: Game di ponsel ini adalah versi resmi yang belum pernah diterjemahkan patcher ini, jadi tidak ada yang dihapus.

removal_verified.en: Translation removed. Normal game app verified.
removal_verified.id: Terjemahan dihapus. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi.

removal_verified_root.en: Translation removed. The game app was not replaced.
removal_verified_root.id: Terjemahan dihapus. Aplikasi game tidak diganti.

removed_login_note.en: Keep using Scan to login. For the official app, reinstall the game from the store.
removed_login_note.id: Tetap gunakan Scan to login. Untuk aplikasi resmi, instal ulang game dari toko.

added_login_note.en: Log in with Scan to login. Direct WeChat or QQ login does not work with this game app.
added_login_note.id: Masuk dengan Scan to login. Login langsung WeChat atau QQ tidak berfungsi dengan aplikasi game ini.

shell_provider_heading.en: How the patcher reaches the game

shell_provider_note.en: Pick what gives the patcher access to the game's files. You can change it whenever no work is running.
shell_provider_note.id: Pilih yang memberi patcher akses ke file game. Pilihan ini bisa diganti kapan saja selama tidak ada proses berjalan.

shizuku_guide_start.en: 2. Start Shizuku, following the steps it shows.
shizuku_guide_start.id: 2. Jalankan Shizuku dengan mengikuti langkah yang ditampilkannya.

shizuku_guide_allow.en: 3. Come back here and tap Start. Allow HOK ACE when Shizuku asks.
shizuku_guide_allow.id: 3. Kembali ke sini dan ketuk Mulai. Izinkan HOK ACE saat Shizuku meminta.

provider_not_ready.en: {provider} arrives in a coming test build. Choose Shizuku for now.
provider_not_ready.id: {provider} hadir di build uji berikutnya. Untuk sekarang, pilih Shizuku.

shizuku_as_root.en: Shizuku is running with root. Choose the Root provider instead.
shizuku_as_root.id: Shizuku berjalan dengan root. Pilih penyedia Root sebagai gantinya.

helper_did_not_start.en: The patcher's helper did not start. Tap Try again. If it happens again, save a log for help. Keep the game closed.
helper_did_not_start.id: Layanan pendukung patcher tidak mulai. Ketuk Coba lagi. Jika terulang, simpan log untuk bantuan. Jangan buka game.

wireless_guide_developer.en: 2. Turn on Developer options: in About phone, tap Build number seven times.
wireless_guide_developer.id: 2. Aktifkan Opsi pengembang: di Tentang ponsel, ketuk Nomor build tujuh kali.

wireless_guide_switch.en: 3. In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging.
wireless_guide_switch.id: 3. Di Opsi pengembang, aktifkan Debugging nirkabel.

wireless_guide_pair.en: 4. Tap Pair here. In Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code, then type the six-digit code into the patcher's notification.
wireless_guide_pair.id: 4. Ketuk Sambungkan di sini. Di Debugging nirkabel, ketuk Sambungkan perangkat dengan kode penyambungan, lalu ketik kode enam digit di notifikasi patcher.

wireless_guide_start.en: 5. Come back here and tap Start. Keep Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging on until the work is done.
wireless_guide_start.id: 5. Kembali ke sini dan ketuk Mulai. Biarkan Wi-Fi dan Debugging nirkabel tetap aktif sampai proses selesai.

wireless_no_wifi.en: Wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi. Connect this phone to a Wi-Fi network, then tap Start again.
wireless_no_wifi.id: Debugging nirkabel memerlukan Wi-Fi. Hubungkan ponsel ini ke jaringan Wi-Fi, lalu ketuk Mulai lagi.

wireless_not_paired.en: Pair the patcher with wireless debugging first. Tap Pair, then follow the steps above.
wireless_not_paired.id: Sambungkan patcher dengan debugging nirkabel terlebih dahulu. Ketuk Sambungkan, lalu ikuti langkah di atas.

wireless_switched_off.en: Wireless debugging is off. Turn it on in Developer options, then tap Start again.
wireless_switched_off.id: Debugging nirkabel nonaktif. Aktifkan di Opsi pengembang, lalu ketuk Mulai lagi.

wireless_refused.en: Wireless debugging no longer trusts the patcher. Tap Pair to pair it again.
wireless_refused.id: Debugging nirkabel tidak lagi memercayai patcher. Ketuk Sambungkan untuk menyambungkannya lagi.

wireless_disconnected_check_recovery.en: Wireless debugging disconnected. Keep the game closed. Turn Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging back on, then check recovery options below.
wireless_disconnected_check_recovery.id: Debugging nirkabel terputus. Jangan buka game. Aktifkan lagi Wi-Fi dan Debugging nirkabel, lalu periksa pilihan pemulihan di bawah.

wireless_disconnected_try_again.en: Wireless debugging disconnected. Keep the game closed. Turn Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging back on, then tap Try again.
wireless_disconnected_try_again.id: Debugging nirkabel terputus. Jangan buka game. Aktifkan lagi Wi-Fi dan Debugging nirkabel, lalu ketuk Coba lagi.

pair_wireless_instruction.en: Turn on Wireless debugging, tap Pair, then type the pairing code into the patcher's notification.
pair_wireless_instruction.id: Aktifkan Debugging nirkabel, ketuk Sambungkan, lalu ketik kode penyambungan di notifikasi patcher.

pair_allow_notifications.en: Allow notifications: you type the pairing code into one. Then tap Pair again.
pair_allow_notifications.id: Izinkan notifikasi: kode penyambungan diketik di notifikasi. Lalu ketuk Sambungkan lagi.

pair_notifications_off.en: Notifications are off for HOK ACE. Turn them on in Android Settings: you type the pairing code into one.
pair_notifications_off.id: Notifikasi HOK ACE nonaktif. Aktifkan di Setelan Android: kode penyambungan diketik di notifikasi.

open_wireless_debugging.en: Open Settings, then Developer options, then Wireless debugging.
open_wireless_debugging.id: Buka Setelan, lalu Opsi pengembang, lalu Debugging nirkabel.

pairing_notification_title.en: Pair HOK ACE with wireless debugging
pairing_notification_title.id: Sambungkan HOK ACE dengan debugging nirkabel

pairing_notification_text.en: In Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code. Then type the six-digit code here.
pairing_notification_text.id: Di Debugging nirkabel, ketuk Sambungkan perangkat dengan kode penyambungan. Lalu ketik kode enam digit di sini.

pairing_checking_code.en: Checking the code with wireless debugging.

pairing_done_text.en: Return to the patcher and tap Start.
pairing_done_text.id: Kembali ke patcher dan ketuk Mulai.

pairing_not_six_digits.en: That was not a six-digit code. Type the code Wireless debugging shows.
pairing_not_six_digits.id: Itu bukan kode enam digit. Ketik kode yang ditampilkan Debugging nirkabel.

pairing_wrong_code.en: The code did not match. Check the code Wireless debugging shows, and type it again.
pairing_wrong_code.id: Kode tidak cocok. Periksa kode yang ditampilkan Debugging nirkabel, lalu ketik lagi.

pairing_screen_not_found.en: The pairing screen was not found. Keep Pair device with pairing code open, then type the code again.
pairing_screen_not_found.id: Layar penyambungan tidak ditemukan. Biarkan Sambungkan perangkat dengan kode penyambungan tetap terbuka, lalu ketik kode lagi.

pairing_did_not_finish.en: Pairing did not finish. Keep Pair device with pairing code open, then type the code again.
pairing_did_not_finish.id: Penyambungan tidak selesai. Biarkan Sambungkan perangkat dengan kode penyambungan tetap terbuka, lalu ketik kode lagi.

keep_the_game_closed_use_recovery_first.en: Keep the game closed. Use recovery first.
keep_the_game_closed_use_recovery_first.id: Jangan buka game. Pulihkan terlebih dahulu.

some_game_text_will_stay_chinese_use.en:
Some game text will stay Chinese.
Use Scan to login after setup.
some_game_text_will_stay_chinese_use.id:
Sebagian teks game tetap berbahasa Mandarin.
Gunakan Scan to login setelah penyiapan.

keep_the_game_closed_any_unfinished.en: Keep the game closed. Any unfinished changes must be restored before you open it.
keep_the_game_closed_any_unfinished.id: Jangan buka game. Semua perubahan yang belum selesai harus dipulihkan sebelum game dibuka.

access_was_not_allowed_tap_start_to_try.en: Access was not allowed. Tap Start to try again.
access_was_not_allowed_tap_start_to_try.id: Akses tidak diizinkan. Ketuk Mulai untuk mencoba lagi.

the_game_is_not_installed_install_it.en: The game is not installed. Install it before preparing files.
the_game_is_not_installed_install_it.id: Game belum terpasang. Pasang game sebelum menyiapkan file.

cannot_open_shizuku_or_google_play.en: Cannot open Shizuku or Google Play. Install Shizuku from play.google.com, start it, then return here.
cannot_open_shizuku_or_google_play.id: Shizuku atau Google Play tidak bisa dibuka. Pasang Shizuku dari play.google.com, jalankan, lalu kembali ke sini.

more_than_one_unfinished_run_was_found.en: More than one unfinished run was found. Choose the correct run in recovery options.
more_than_one_unfinished_run_was_found.id: Ada lebih dari satu proses yang belum selesai. Pilih proses yang sesuai di pilihan pemulihan.

saved_progress_cannot_be_read_keep_the.en: Saved progress cannot be read. Keep the game closed and save a log for help.
saved_progress_cannot_be_read_keep_the.id: Progres tersimpan tidak bisa dibaca. Jangan buka game dan simpan log untuk bantuan.

work_could_not_start_check_provider.en: Work could not start. Check {provider}, then tap Start again.
work_could_not_start_check_provider.id: Proses tidak bisa dimulai. Periksa {provider}, lalu ketuk Mulai lagi.

work_was_interrupted_tap_start_to_check.en: Work was interrupted. Tap Start to check and restore unfinished work.
work_was_interrupted_tap_start_to_check.id: Proses terhenti. Ketuk Mulai untuk memeriksa dan memulihkan proses yang belum selesai.

please_wait_we_are_checking_the_saved.en: Please wait. We are checking the saved game app and recovery files.
please_wait_we_are_checking_the_saved.id: Mohon tunggu. Aplikasi game tersimpan dan file pemulihan sedang diperiksa.

keep_the_game_closed_save_a_log_for_help.en: Keep the game closed. Save a log for help.
keep_the_game_closed_save_a_log_for_help.id: Jangan buka game. Simpan log untuk bantuan.

shizuku_must_be_running_start_it_then.en: Shizuku must be running. Start it, then return here. We will continue automatically.
shizuku_must_be_running_start_it_then.id: Shizuku harus berjalan. Jalankan, lalu kembali ke sini. Proses akan dilanjutkan otomatis.

shizuku_is_required_install_it_from.en: Shizuku is required. Install it from Google Play, start it, then return here.
shizuku_is_required_install_it_from.id: Shizuku diperlukan. Pasang dari Google Play, jalankan, lalu kembali ke sini.

notification_permission_reason.en: Allow notifications to see the patch's progress and hear when it is done.
notification_permission_reason.id: Izinkan notifikasi untuk melihat kemajuan patch dan tahu saat patch selesai.

work_stopped_notification.en: Tap to see what happened and what to do next.
work_stopped_notification.id: Ketuk untuk melihat apa yang terjadi dan langkah berikutnya.

we_will_check_unfinished_work_and.en: We will check unfinished work and recover it before patching.
we_will_check_unfinished_work_and.id: Proses yang belum selesai akan diperiksa dan dipulihkan sebelum memasang patch.

tap_start_we_will_check_your_game_and.en: Tap Start. We will check your game and prepare everything. Keep the game closed while we work.
tap_start_we_will_check_your_game_and.id: Ketuk Mulai. Game akan diperiksa dan semua file disiapkan. Jangan buka game selama proses.

shizuku_is_running_but_the_patchers.en: Shizuku is running, but the patcher's helper did not start. Open Shizuku, stop it and start it again, then return here and tap Try again. If it happens again, save a log for help. Keep the game closed.
shizuku_is_running_but_the_patchers.id: Shizuku berjalan, tetapi layanan pendukung patcher tidak mulai. Buka Shizuku, hentikan lalu jalankan lagi, kemudian kembali ke sini dan ketuk Coba lagi. Jika terulang, simpan log untuk bantuan. Jangan buka game.

open_shizuku_start_it_and_allow_hok_ace.en: Open Shizuku. Start it and allow HOK ACE. Return here and retry. Keep the game closed.
open_shizuku_start_it_and_allow_hok_ace.id: Buka dan jalankan Shizuku, lalu izinkan HOK ACE. Kembali ke sini dan coba lagi. Jangan buka game.

the_game_is_also_installed_in_another.en: The game is also installed in another Android profile, such as Dual App or a work profile. Remove it from that profile, then tap Try again. Keep the game closed.
the_game_is_also_installed_in_another.id: Game juga terpasang di profil Android lain, misalnya Aplikasi Ganda (Dual App) atau profil kerja. Hapus game dari profil tersebut, lalu ketuk Coba lagi. Jangan buka game.

this_phone_has_another_android_profile.en: This phone has another Android profile, such as Dual App, that could not be checked for the game. Remove the game from Dual App, then tap Try again. If it happens again, save a log for help. Keep the game closed.
this_phone_has_another_android_profile.id: Ponsel ini memiliki profil Android lain, misalnya Aplikasi Ganda (Dual App), yang tidak dapat diperiksa. Hapus game dari Aplikasi Ganda, lalu ketuk Coba lagi. Jika terjadi lagi, simpan log untuk bantuan. Jangan buka game.

the_installed_game_app_is_not_the_saved.en: The installed game app is not the saved app this check looks for. It is a different app, not a damaged one. If no patch was started, tap Try again. Otherwise check recovery options below, or save a log for help. Keep the game closed.
the_installed_game_app_is_not_the_saved.id: Aplikasi game yang terpasang bukan aplikasi tersimpan yang diperiksa. Aplikasinya berbeda, bukan rusak. Jika patch belum dimulai, ketuk Coba lagi. Jika sudah, periksa pilihan pemulihan di bawah atau simpan log untuk bantuan. Jangan buka game.

phone_refused_step_check_recovery.en: The phone refused a step, although {provider} is working. Keep the game closed. Check recovery options below, or save a log for help.
phone_refused_step_check_recovery.id: Ponsel menolak satu langkah, meskipun {provider} berjalan. Jangan buka game. Periksa pilihan pemulihan di bawah atau simpan log untuk bantuan.

phone_refused_step_try_again.en: The phone refused a step, although {provider} is working. Keep the game closed. Tap Try again, or save a log for help.
phone_refused_step_try_again.id: Ponsel menolak satu langkah, meskipun {provider} berjalan. Jangan buka game. Ketuk Coba lagi atau simpan log untuk bantuan.

work_stopped_keep_the_game_closed_try_ag.en: Work stopped. Keep the game closed. Tap Try again, or save a log for help.
work_stopped_keep_the_game_closed_try_ag.id: Proses terhenti. Jangan buka game. Ketuk Coba lagi atau simpan log untuk bantuan.

the_phone_blocked_installation_unlock_it.en: The phone blocked installation. Unlock it and accept the install prompt. Open Technical tools for the full error.
the_phone_blocked_installation_unlock_it.id: Ponsel memblokir pemasangan. Buka kunci dan setujui permintaan pemasangan. Buka Alat teknis untuk melihat galat lengkap.

work_stopped_keep_the_game_closed_check.en: Work stopped. Keep the game closed. Check recovery options below, or save a log for help.
work_stopped_keep_the_game_closed_check.id: Proses terhenti. Jangan buka game. Periksa pilihan pemulihan di bawah atau simpan log untuk bantuan.

the_phone_did_not_report_how_much_more.en: The phone did not report how much more space is needed. Free space elsewhere and retry. Keep saved recovery files.
the_phone_did_not_report_how_much_more.id: Ponsel tidak melaporkan tambahan ruang yang diperlukan. Kosongkan ruang lain lalu coba lagi. Simpan file pemulihan.

choose_prepared_game_files.id: Pilih file game yang sudah disiapkan

choose_game_files_for_first_setup.en: Choose game files for first setup
choose_game_files_for_first_setup.id: Pilih file game untuk penyiapan awal

i_accept_deletion_of_the_games_local.en: I accept deletion of the game's local data
i_accept_deletion_of_the_games_local.id: Saya menyetujui penghapusan data lokal game

i_will_use_scan_to_login.en: I will use Scan to login
i_will_use_scan_to_login.id: Saya akan menggunakan Scan to login

first_setup_deletes_local_game_data.en: First setup deletes local game data
first_setup_deletes_local_game_data.id: Penyiapan awal menghapus data lokal game

check_the_installed_app_and_restore_the.en: Check the installed app and restore the verified normal game app if it is absent. Recovery will not repeat removal. Deleted local game data cannot be restored by this step.
check_the_installed_app_and_restore_the.id: Periksa aplikasi terpasang dan pulihkan aplikasi game normal yang terverifikasi jika tidak ada. Pemulihan tidak akan menghapus ulang. Langkah ini tidak bisa memulihkan data lokal yang sudah dihapus.

every_fresh_game_update_finished_and_i.en: Every fresh game update finished, and I closed the game
every_fresh_game_update_finished_and_i.id: Semua pembaruan game yang baru diunduh sudah selesai dan game sudah saya tutup

the_game_cannot_be_opened_use_recovery.en: The game cannot be opened. Use recovery.
the_game_cannot_be_opened_use_recovery.id: Game tidak bisa dibuka. Gunakan pemulihan.

all_in_game_updates_finished_and_i.en: All in-game updates finished, and I closed the game
all_in_game_updates_finished_and_i.id: Semua pembaruan dalam game sudah selesai dan game sudah saya tutup

choose_emergency_normal_apk.id: Pilih APK normal untuk pemulihan darurat

patch_after_the_game_update_finishes.en: Patch after the game update finishes
patch_after_the_game_update_finishes.id: Pasang patch setelah pembaruan game selesai

check_shell_and_game_apk_path.en: Check shell and game APK path
check_shell_and_game_apk_path.id: Periksa shell dan lokasi APK game

copy_and_verify_installed_apk_about_2_gb.en: Copy and verify installed APK (about 2 GB)
copy_and_verify_installed_apk_about_2_gb.id: Salin dan periksa APK terpasang (sekitar 2 GB)

verify_installed_normal_apk_with.en: Verify installed normal APK with foreground worker
verify_installed_normal_apk_with.id: Periksa APK normal terpasang dengan proses latar depan

no_pending_game_setup.id: Tidak ada penyiapan game yang tertunda

no_interrupted_patch_to_recover.id: Tidak ada patch terhenti yang perlu dipulihkan

checking_the_installed_normal_game_app.en: Checking the installed normal game app
checking_the_installed_normal_game_app.id: Memeriksa aplikasi game normal yang terpasang

checking_other_android_profiles_for_the.en: Checking other Android profiles for the game
checking_other_android_profiles_for_the.id: Memeriksa game di profil Android lain

the_game_is_installed_but_hidden_or.en: The game is installed but hidden or switched off in this phone's main space, for example by Hide apps. Show it again, open it once, close it, then tap Try again.
the_game_is_installed_but_hidden_or.id: Game terpasang, tetapi disembunyikan atau dinonaktifkan di ruang utama ponsel ini, misalnya oleh fitur Sembunyikan aplikasi. Tampilkan lagi, buka sekali, tutup, lalu ketuk Coba lagi.

the_game_is_installed_only_in_dual_app.en: The game is installed only in Dual App. Install it in the phone's main space too, open it once and finish all downloads, close it, then tap Try again.
the_game_is_installed_only_in_dual_app.id: Game hanya terpasang di Aplikasi Ganda. Pasang juga di ruang utama ponsel, buka sekali dan selesaikan semua unduhan, tutup game, lalu ketuk Coba lagi.

the_game_is_not_installed_in_this_phones.en: The game is not installed in this phone's main space. Install it there (Dual App alone is not enough), open it once and finish all downloads, close it, then tap Try again.
the_game_is_not_installed_in_this_phones.id: Game belum terpasang di ruang utama ponsel ini. Pasang game di sana (Aplikasi Ganda saja tidak cukup), buka sekali dan selesaikan semua unduhan, tutup game, lalu ketuk Coba lagi.

storage_shortage.en:
Need {need} GB free for this step.
Free now: {free} GB.
Clear at least {more} GB more, then try again.
Keep saved recovery files.
storage_shortage.id:
Langkah ini memerlukan {need} GB ruang kosong.
Tersedia: {free} GB.
Kosongkan setidaknya {more} GB lagi, lalu coba lagi.
Simpan file pemulihan.

storage_enough.en:
Enough space now for this step.
Needed: {need} GB free (rounded up).
Tap Try again. Keep saved recovery files.
storage_enough.id:
Ruang sekarang cukup untuk langkah ini.
Diperlukan: {need} GB (dibulatkan ke atas).
Ketuk Coba lagi. Simpan file pemulihan.

progress_fallback.en: Working on game files. See the log below for details.
progress_fallback.id: Sedang memproses file game. Lihat rincian di log di bawah.

completed_no_counts.en: Patch complete. Normal game app verified; result counts are unavailable.
completed_no_counts.id: Patch selesai. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi; jumlah hasil tidak tersedia.

completed_no_counts_root.en: Patch complete. The game app was not replaced; result counts are unavailable.
completed_no_counts_root.id: Patch selesai. Aplikasi game tidak diganti; jumlah hasil tidak tersedia.

first_setup_consent.en:
1. This deletes saved game data, downloads and login on this phone.

2. Download all game updates again.

3. Direct WeChat/QQ login stops working. Use Scan to login.

4. Translation is added later, after you confirm that downloads finished.

First setup has not passed all phone tests.
first_setup_consent.id:
1. Data game, unduhan, dan login tersimpan di ponsel ini akan dihapus.

2. Unduh ulang semua pembaruan game.

3. Login langsung WeChat/QQ tidak akan berfungsi. Gunakan Scan to login.

4. Terjemahan ditambahkan setelah Anda mengonfirmasi unduhan selesai.

Penyiapan awal belum lulus semua pengujian ponsel.

setup_update.en: Open the game, complete all downloads, then close it. We will then prepare the new files automatically. Translation starts after the final update confirmation.
setup_update.id: Buka game, selesaikan semua unduhan, lalu tutup game. File baru akan disiapkan otomatis. Terjemahan dimulai setelah konfirmasi pembaruan terakhir.

patch_confirmation.en:
1. Finish ALL downloads in the game.
2. Close the game.

3. We change game files and briefly replace the game app.

4. Keep the game CLOSED until work or recovery finishes.

Language: {language}

Adding the translation has not passed all phone tests.
patch_confirmation.id:
1. Selesaikan SEMUA unduhan dalam game.
2. Tutup game.

3. Kami akan mengubah file game dan mengganti aplikasi game untuk sementara.

4. JANGAN BUKA game sampai proses atau pemulihan selesai.

Bahasa: {language}

Penerapan terjemahan belum lulus semua pengujian ponsel.

restore_apk_only.en: Restore version {version} with data retained. This restores the APK only. Unresolved package writes still require rollback before launching the game. Opening the installer does not verify a completed restoration.
restore_apk_only.id: Pulihkan versi {version} tanpa menghapus data. Ini hanya memulihkan APK. Penulisan paket yang belum selesai masih harus dipulihkan sebelum game dibuka. Membuka pemasang tidak berarti pemulihan sudah terverifikasi.

before_you_start_tips.en:
1.  Enable USB debugging on the phone, connect the USB cable and tap 'Allow'.
2.  Open the game once until the data download finishes (login screen), then close it.
3.  If Google Play Protect asks, tap 'More details' → 'Install anyway'.
before_you_start_tips.id:
1.  Aktifkan USB debugging di ponsel, sambungkan kabel USB, lalu ketuk 'Izinkan'.
2.  Buka game sekali sampai unduhan data selesai (layar login), lalu tutup game.
3.  Jika Google Play Protect bertanya, ketuk 'Detail lainnya' → 'Tetap instal'.

working_folder_label.en: WORKING FOLDER  ·  temporary game data, about 8 GB
working_folder_label.id: FOLDER KERJA  ·  data game sementara, sekitar 8 GB

choose_folder_title.en: Choose a folder for the temporary game data
choose_folder_title.id: Pilih folder untuk data game sementara

ready_connect_phone.en: Connect your phone and click Start. Keep the game closed while we work.
ready_connect_phone.id: Hubungkan ponsel dan klik Mulai. Jangan buka game selama proses.

already_untranslated.en: The game files were already untranslated.

reads_chinese_again.en: The game reads in Chinese again.

failed_status.en: The cause is below. Fix it, then click Try again. Save the log if you need help.
failed_status.id: Penyebabnya ada di bawah. Perbaiki, lalu klik Coba lagi. Simpan log jika perlu bantuan.

result_open_game.en:
Open the game on your phone.

Login: use 'Scan to login' (the direct WeChat/QQ buttons do not work). With one phone: screenshot the QR code, open WeChat in split screen and scan it from the gallery.
result_open_game.id:
Buka game di ponsel.

Login: gunakan 'Scan to login' (tombol WeChat/QQ langsung tidak berfungsi). Dengan satu ponsel: tangkap layar kode QR, buka WeChat dalam layar terpisah, lalu pindai dari galeri.

unexpected_error.en: An unexpected error occurred. See the log in this window.
unexpected_error.id: Terjadi galat tak terduga. Lihat log di jendela ini.

close_while_busy.en:
Closing now can leave the game unable to start until the patcher is run again.

Close anyway?
close_while_busy.id:
Menutup sekarang dapat membuat game tidak bisa dibuka sampai patcher dijalankan lagi.

Tetap tutup?

reinstall_required.en:
The game on this phone uses the official Tencent signature, so it must be reinstalled with the patcher signature.

This DELETES the game data on the phone and the game will download its data again (~1.7 GB). Direct WeChat/QQ login will no longer work; use 'Scan to login' instead.

Continue?
reinstall_required.id:
Game di ponsel ini memakai tanda tangan resmi Tencent, jadi harus dipasang ulang dengan tanda tangan patcher.

Ini MENGHAPUS data game di ponsel dan game akan mengunduh datanya lagi (~1,7 GB). Login langsung WeChat/QQ tidak akan berfungsi lagi; gunakan 'Scan to login'.

Lanjutkan?

download_game_data.en:
Open the game on the phone, accept the policies and wait until the data download finishes and the login screen appears.

Then CLOSE the game and click OK here.
download_game_data.id:
Buka game di ponsel, setujui kebijakannya, dan tunggu sampai unduhan data selesai dan layar login muncul.

Lalu TUTUP game dan klik OK di sini.

retry_install.en: Installing the normal game APK failed. Try again?
retry_install.id: Pemasangan APK game normal gagal. Coba lagi?

the_game_could_not_update_translated.en: The game could not update the files this patcher translated. Re-download them: only those game files are deleted, and the game downloads them again. The rest of the game data is kept.
the_game_could_not_update_translated.id: Game tidak bisa memperbarui file yang diterjemahkan patcher ini. Unduh ulang file tersebut: hanya file game itu yang dihapus, lalu game mengunduhnya lagi. Data game lainnya tetap ada.

some_game_files_are_still_translated.en: Some game files are still translated

a_game_update_kept_part_of_translation.en: A game update kept part of the earlier translation in some game files, so the patcher cannot restore them. Re-download them: only those game files are deleted, and the game downloads them again. The rest of the game data is kept.
a_game_update_kept_part_of_translation.id: Pembaruan game menyisakan sebagian terjemahan sebelumnya di beberapa file game, sehingga patcher tidak bisa memulihkannya. Unduh ulang file tersebut: hanya file game itu yang dihapus, lalu game mengunduhnya lagi. Data game lainnya tetap ada.

the_patcher_cannot_restore_untranslated.en: The patcher cannot restore the untranslated game files. Clear the game's data in Android Settings, open the game and let it download again to the login screen, close it, then tap Start. Open Technical tools for the reason.
the_patcher_cannot_restore_untranslated.id: Patcher tidak bisa memulihkan file game yang belum diterjemahkan. Hapus data game di Pengaturan Android, buka game dan biarkan mengunduh lagi sampai layar login, tutup, lalu ketuk Mulai. Buka Alat teknis untuk melihat alasannya.

open_the_game_finish_update_then_start.en: Open the game and let it finish the update to the login screen. Close it, then tap Start to patch again.
open_the_game_finish_update_then_start.id: Buka game dan biarkan pembaruan selesai sampai layar login. Tutup game, lalu ketuk Mulai untuk menambal lagi.

redownload_confirmation.en:
The game's update stopped on the files this patcher translated. This deletes only those game files and clears the game's update records, so the game downloads them again on its next start. Nothing else is deleted.

Then open the game, let it finish the update to the login screen, close it, and tap Start to patch again.
redownload_confirmation.id:
Pembaruan game berhenti pada file yang diterjemahkan patcher ini. Ini hanya menghapus file game tersebut dan catatan pembaruan game, sehingga game mengunduhnya lagi saat dibuka berikutnya. Tidak ada yang lain yang dihapus.

Lalu buka game, biarkan pembaruan selesai sampai layar login, tutup game, dan ketuk Mulai untuk menambal lagi.

redownload_verified.en: Damaged files deleted. Normal game app verified.
redownload_verified.id: File rusak dihapus. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi.

redownload_verified_root.en: Damaged files deleted. The game app was not replaced.
redownload_verified_root.id: File rusak dihapus. Aplikasi game tidak diganti.

redownload_next_step.en: Open the game, let it finish the update to the login screen, close it, then tap Start to patch again.
redownload_next_step.id: Buka game, biarkan pembaruan selesai sampai layar login, tutup game, lalu ketuk Mulai untuk menambal lagi.

redownloading_damaged_game_files.id: Mengunduh ulang file game yang rusak

finding_package_files_update_could_not_c.en: Finding the package files the game update could not change
finding_package_files_update_could_not_c.id: Mencari file paket yang tidak bisa diubah pembaruan game

drive_free_not_enough.en: {free} GB free on this drive: not enough. Choose a folder on another drive.
drive_free_not_enough.id: {free} GB kosong di drive ini: tidak cukup. Pilih folder di drive lain.

device_one_phone_only.en: More than one phone or emulator is connected. Keep only one.
device_one_phone_only.id: Lebih dari satu ponsel atau emulator terhubung. Sisakan satu saja.

device_allow_usb_debugging.en: On the phone, tap 'Allow' on the 'Allow USB debugging' prompt.
device_allow_usb_debugging.id: Di ponsel, ketuk 'Izinkan' pada permintaan 'Izinkan debugging USB'.

device_connect_usb.en: Connect the phone with a USB cable and enable USB debugging (Settings > Developer options > USB debugging).
device_connect_usb.id: Hubungkan ponsel dengan kabel USB dan aktifkan debugging USB (Setelan > Opsi developer > Debugging USB).

clear_game_data.en: Clear the game's data on the phone (Settings > Apps > the game > Storage > Clear data), open the game and let it download again to the login screen, close it, then run the patcher again.
clear_game_data.id: Hapus data game di ponsel (Setelan > Aplikasi > game > Penyimpanan > Hapus data), buka game dan biarkan mengunduh lagi sampai layar login, tutup game, lalu jalankan patcher lagi.

use_other_patcher.en: If the Android patcher patched this phone last, patch it with that patcher instead.
use_other_patcher.id: Jika patcher Android yang terakhir mem-patch ponsel ini, gunakan patcher itu untuk mem-patch-nya.

error_work_dir_full.en: Not enough disk space in the working folder ({path}). At least 8 GB free is needed (currently {free} GB). Choose a folder on another drive.
error_work_dir_full.id: Ruang disk di folder kerja tidak cukup ({path}). Diperlukan minimal 8 GB kosong (saat ini {free} GB). Pilih folder di drive lain.

error_read_failed.en:
Could not read data from the phone:
{output}
error_read_failed.id:
Tidak dapat membaca data dari ponsel:
{output}

error_play_protect_blocked.en: Google Play Protect blocked the install. Try again and on the phone tap 'More details' -> 'Install anyway'.
error_play_protect_blocked.id: Google Play Protect memblokir pemasangan. Coba lagi, lalu di ponsel ketuk 'Detail lainnya' -> 'Tetap instal'.

error_game_not_installed.en: HOK ACE (王者万象棋) is not installed on this phone. Install the game first.
error_game_not_installed.id: HOK ACE (王者万象棋) belum terpasang di ponsel ini. Pasang game terlebih dahulu.

error_split_apks.en: This game build is installed as split APKs, which the patcher does not support yet.
error_split_apks.id: Build game ini terpasang sebagai split APK, yang belum didukung patcher.

error_official_nothing_to_remove.en: The game on this phone is the official build, which this patcher never translated, so there is nothing to remove.
error_official_nothing_to_remove.id: Game di ponsel ini adalah build resmi, yang tidak pernah diterjemahkan patcher ini, jadi tidak ada yang perlu dihapus.

error_game_data_missing.en: The game data has not been downloaded yet. Open the game, wait for the download to reach the login screen, close the game, then run the patcher again.
error_game_data_missing.id: Data game belum diunduh. Buka game, tunggu unduhan sampai layar login, tutup game, lalu jalankan patcher lagi.

error_delta_damaged.en: The patcher's record of the untranslated game files is damaged ({error}).
error_delta_damaged.id: Catatan patcher tentang file game yang belum diterjemahkan rusak ({error}).

error_cannot_rebuild.en: This phone is already translated, and the patcher cannot rebuild its untranslated game files.
error_cannot_rebuild.id: Ponsel ini sudah diterjemahkan, dan patcher tidak dapat membangun ulang file game yang belum diterjemahkan.

error_files_changed.en: The game files changed since the last patch (a game update or repair), so the patcher cannot rebuild the untranslated files.
error_files_changed.id: File game berubah sejak patch terakhir (pembaruan atau perbaikan game), sehingga patcher tidak dapat membangun ulang file yang belum diterjemahkan.

error_uncovered_files.en: Some translated game files are not covered by the patcher's record.
error_uncovered_files.id: Sebagian file game yang diterjemahkan tidak tercakup dalam catatan patcher.

error_update_kept_translation.en: The game update left some of this patcher's translation in the files it changed, so the patcher cannot rebuild the untranslated files.
error_update_kept_translation.id: Pembaruan game menyisakan sebagian terjemahan patcher ini di file yang diubahnya, sehingga patcher tidak dapat membangun ulang file yang belum diterjemahkan.

error_translated_elsewhere.en: This phone is already translated (by an older patcher version or another patcher), so the patcher cannot switch or update the translation without its untranslated game files.
error_translated_elsewhere.id: Ponsel ini sudah diterjemahkan (oleh versi patcher lama atau patcher lain), sehingga patcher tidak dapat mengganti atau memperbarui terjemahan tanpa file game yang belum diterjemahkan.

error_no_record_to_remove.en: This patcher has no record of a translation on this phone, so there is nothing to remove.
error_no_record_to_remove.id: Patcher ini tidak punya catatan terjemahan di ponsel ini, jadi tidak ada yang perlu dihapus.

root_guide_root.en: 1. Root this phone with a root manager, such as KernelSU, Magisk or APatch.
root_guide_root.id: 1. Root ponsel ini dengan pengelola root, seperti KernelSU, Magisk, atau APatch.

root_guide_allow.en: 2. Allow root for HOK ACE: in KernelSU, under Superuser, then close and reopen HOK ACE; Magisk and APatch ask when you tap Start.
root_guide_allow.id: 2. Izinkan root untuk HOK ACE: di KernelSU, pada Superuser, lalu tutup dan buka lagi HOK ACE; Magisk dan APatch bertanya saat Anda mengetuk Mulai.

root_guide_start.en: 3. Come back here and tap Start. The patcher writes the game files itself and never replaces the game app.
root_guide_start.id: 3. Kembali ke sini dan ketuk Mulai. Patcher menulis file game sendiri dan tidak pernah mengganti aplikasi game.

root_guide_hiding.en: 4. Hiding root from the game is up to you; the patcher does not touch it.
root_guide_hiding.id: 4. Menyembunyikan root dari game adalah urusan Anda; patcher tidak menyentuhnya.

root_no_access.en: Root access is not available to HOK ACE. Allow HOK ACE in your root manager, such as KernelSU, Magisk or APatch, then close and reopen HOK ACE and tap Start.
root_no_access.id: Akses root tidak tersedia untuk HOK ACE. Izinkan HOK ACE di pengelola root Anda, seperti KernelSU, Magisk, atau APatch, lalu tutup dan buka lagi HOK ACE dan ketuk Mulai.

root_not_root.en: Root access did not give HOK ACE root. Check HOK ACE in your root manager, then tap Start again.
root_not_root.id: Akses root tidak memberi HOK ACE hak root. Periksa HOK ACE di pengelola root Anda, lalu ketuk Mulai lagi.

root_access_build_installed.en: The installed game app is the patcher's temporary access build. Recover the game app with the provider that patched it, then try again.
root_access_build_installed.id: Aplikasi game yang terpasang adalah versi akses sementara dari patcher. Pulihkan aplikasi game dengan penyedia yang menambalnya, lalu coba lagi.

recover_with_other_provider.en: This interrupted run was started with another shell provider. Choose that provider to recover it.
recover_with_other_provider.id: Proses yang terhenti ini dimulai dengan penyedia shell lain. Pilih penyedia itu untuk memulihkannya.

root_disconnected_check_recovery.en: Root access stopped. Keep the game closed. Check HOK ACE in your root manager, then check recovery options below.
root_disconnected_check_recovery.id: Akses root berhenti. Jangan buka game. Periksa HOK ACE di pengelola root Anda, lalu periksa pilihan pemulihan di bawah.

root_disconnected_try_again.en: Root access stopped. Keep the game closed. Check HOK ACE in your root manager, then tap Try again.
root_disconnected_try_again.id: Akses root berhenti. Jangan buka game. Periksa HOK ACE di pengelola root Anda, lalu ketuk Coba lagi.

progress_root_skips_access.en: Skipped Unlock access: Root reads the game files directly, with no access app
progress_root_skips_access.id: Buka akses dilewati: Root membaca file game secara langsung, tanpa aplikasi akses

progress_root_skips_restore.en: Skipped Restore game app: Root never replaced the game app
progress_root_skips_restore.id: Pulihkan aplikasi game dilewati: Root tidak pernah mengganti aplikasi game

progress_root_check_copy.en: Checking the saved copy of the game app

progress_root_reuse_copy.en: Reusing the verified saved copy of the game app
progress_root_reuse_copy.id: Memakai ulang salinan tersimpan aplikasi game yang sudah diverifikasi

progress_root_recovered.en: Game app verified; interrupted session recovered
progress_root_recovered.id: Aplikasi game terverifikasi; sesi yang terhenti dipulihkan

patch_confirmation_root.en:
1. Finish ALL downloads in the game.
2. Close the game.

3. We change game files with root. The game app is not replaced.

4. Keep the game CLOSED until work or recovery finishes.

Language: {language}

Adding the translation has not passed all phone tests.
patch_confirmation_root.id:
1. Selesaikan SEMUA unduhan dalam game.
2. Tutup game.

3. Kami akan mengubah file game dengan root. Aplikasi game tidak diganti.

4. JANGAN BUKA game sampai proses atau pemulihan selesai.

Bahasa: {language}

Penerapan terjemahan belum lulus semua pengujian ponsel.

remove_confirmation_root.en:
This writes the game's original files back, so the game reads in Chinese again. No game data is deleted and no download is needed.

The game app is not changed.
remove_confirmation_root.id:
Ini menulis kembali file game asli, sehingga game kembali berbahasa Tionghoa. Data game tidak dihapus dan tidak perlu mengunduh ulang.

Aplikasi game tidak diubah.
